limitations: Gyro columns kept in dataset order; axis mapping to Android requires device calibration.
10 Hz IMU is sample-held to 100 Hz for the live filter. This adds no signal detail.
Repeated coordinate/speed/bearing tuples are not new fixes. Missing speed/course accuracies assumed 0.5 m/s and 10 degrees for replay only.
Phone speed is inferred as m/s from coordinate displacement, despite Kmh header. See per-recording audit ratios.
Vehicle GNSS reference is not surveyed ground truth. Outages are deliberately injected, not actual tunnel labels.
Compass is reconstructed from recorded gravity and magnetometer with Android ENU equations; no reference-trajectory heading is supplied to the estimator.
Original gyro columns are used as sensor x/y/z; ambiguous yaw/pitch/roll labels remain a source-frame uncertainty.
Driver A was evaluated previously and is a regression set, not new blind validation.
